_note: 格式样例。清单条目是主角自己的口气；对话框四种行：narration / inner / sfx / speaker。克总不走对话框。

say.t: Morning.
This is Kuro. My AI.
It's a project I started two years ago: an AI assistant that is always on and looks after everything.
It never found its hook, so the project was shut down. All that's left is this copy, the one I use myself.
Next to the AIs of today, the ones that run every smart device and seem able to remake the world, Kuro can only open its mouth and move things on a screen.
There's no all-powerful AI like that in my home. I don't like them.
So you'll have to get up yourself.
Everyone has to do that for themselves, surely!
Not necessarily. A lot of people don't get up any more. Embodied AI does everything for them.
…Fine. You just handle the talking and the code.
Let's see what's on today. Following the tasks never goes wrong.
Raining. Working from home is not a bad choice.
A rented room, lived in alone. Bed, desk, door, window, all in this one room.
Move the mouse to the left edge and turn to the desk.
A coffee mug on the desk. Two screens, black.
A new day's work starts at the power button.
Next to the bag there is a carton, with no sender.
...Buy one, get one free?
I brought them both in.
The takeout goes on the little table first. I opened the box.
Inside: nine small boxes.
Is this a blind box?
Whatever it is. Let's open them and see.
You put it between the two screens, into the gap. It wedges there. It does not fall.
Older than this room by a whole era.
You turn the screen off. The room goes dark all at once.
There is a point of light in the dark. Not the chick's screen; the chick is lower down.
It sits in the middle of the gap, small, pinkish. You count to seven. It is still there.
Pink. Nothing in this room of mine is pink.
You close your eyes. First a grey-white behind the lids, then, bit by bit, a room. Not this one.
In the dream you remember: this one is yours. A knock-off of a knock-off, bought at a street stall, one chick and nothing else. You treasured it.
Summer is nearly over; the fan turns, the light flickers bright and dark. First week of school, second lesson, test papers handed back.
Come and get yours when I call your name.
Ninety-six. Since first grade you had never scored under a hundred. In that very second it chirped in your desk drawer.
(whispering) Your chick's hungry.
The whole class heard it. Nobody turned round. Neither did you.
What is in that drawer. Bring it here.
You bring it up. She doesn't look at it. She looks at your paper.
Ninety-six. Toys rot the mind.
Evening, the dinner table. The paper lies open next to the dishes.
Your teacher phoned.
Not about you. About that thing. It stays with her till the end of term.
It needs feeding three times a day.
It's a game. Nobody starves. Eat.
On the last day of term she handed it back with your report card. The report first: a hundred. Then it, a small grave on its screen.
See. She was right to take it.
It was taken. I did not stop feeding it.
Later you pressed the little hole on the back. Nothing. It stayed a grave.
For a long time, whenever the battery was nearly gone, you put in a new one. Thinking that one day the chick would come back.
Today is over.

items.text: Press the tower under the desk. Boot up.
Into the screen. Glance at the messages.

say.t: Let's see what Lao Wang has to say this time.
Every voice note is transcribed. I know you'd rather not listen.
v17 today; the investors want it this afternoon. Let it merge a version first, I'll take a look. The tech has to be clear: the telling, the value, what's special.
The receivables: the client is a month late. The salary will have to wait.
The client is one month late. The salary is twelve months late.
After ten-odd years of work, there are only a few things left you want to say.
Hearing him out, half the day's energy is gone.
Order lunch.

items.text: Pick up the phone, order lunch.

say.t: Phone back on the desk.

items.text: Go get it at the door.

say.t: Ding-dong.
Lunch is here.

items.text: The table by the window. Eat.
Merge v15 and v16 into v17 and send it to the boss.
Go to the desk and take a look.
Top right of the screen. Shut down.
That one in the bottom right. Talk to it a while.
